# Tutorials

Tutorials provide goal-oriented, step-by-step paths through complete RECAP
workflows. Start with one tutorial and follow it from setup through working
code, then use the [How-To guides](../how-to/index.qmd),
[Explanation](../explanation/index.qmd), and [Reference](/reference/index.html)
for focused procedures, concepts, and exact API details.

## Domain Models

- [Resource Examples](resource-examples.qmd): reusable file and instrument resource shapes. See [resource templates](../how-to/resource-template.qmd) and [builder API](/reference/ResourceTemplateBuilder.html).

## Provenance Workflows

- [Complete Local Provenance](complete-local-provenance.qmd): sample hierarchy, process run, parameters, and local provenance query. See [create resources](../how-to/create-resources.qmd), [build process runs](../how-to/build-process-runs.qmd), and [trace provenance](../how-to/provenance-queries.qmd).

## Remote Integration

- [Remote Client](remote-client.qmd): same sample workflow through `RecapClient.from_url()`, REST mutations, and GraphQL-backed queries. See [remote authentication](../how-to/use-remote-authentication.qmd), [client API](/reference/RecapClient.html), and [query API](/reference/QueryDSL.html).
